summary_en: 1,200,000 shares (1.9% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired for ¥1,777.2M (upper limit) via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-28 at opening. Closing price baseline 2026-07-27: ¥1,481/share. Single-execution window (8:45 a.m. JST); partial execution possible depending on market conditions.
title_en: Notice on Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Public Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Konishi Co., Ltd. announced on 2026-07-27 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 1,200,000 treasury shares (1.9% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥1,777.2M via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours electronic auction). The acquisition will be executed on 2026-07-28 at 8:45 a.m. JST at the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with the purchase order placed using the closing price of 2026-07-27 (¥1,481/share) as the baseline. The company states the rationale is to enhance shareholder returns and enable flexible capital-allocation execution to improve capital efficiency. Execution is a single-window event; partial or no acquisition is possible if market conditions prevent full order matching. Results will be disclosed at market open on 2026-07-28.
